items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 23 at 1:40PM CST until November 25 at 3:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas
4 to 7 ft expected.

* WHERE...Portions of Gulf of America.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Tuesday to 3 PM CST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Small craft should also exercise caution
tonight as the northeasterly winds begin to strengthen.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
